local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local f=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*d.x-f.x*d.y,f.x*d.x+f.y*d.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(f.z,math.sqrt(f.x*f.x+f.y*f.y))-math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
local points={{util.vector3(812.5128,1799.6964,-254),util.vector3(737.581298828125,1629.49365234375,-210.0),util.vector3(926.6140747070312,1596.3486328125,-216.0),util.vector3(1155.23974609375,1530.0281982421875,-244.0),util.vector3(1400.98388671875,1546.8193359375,-278.0),util.vector3(1584.9156494140625,1545.891845703125,-292.0),util.vector3(1764.64453125,1636.10205078125,-292.0),util.vector3(1937.683837890625,1640.5780029296875,-292.0),util.vector3(2084.6103515625,1653.540771484375,-292.0),util.vector3(2311.430908203125,1540.0,-292.0),util.vector3(2556.18408203125,1540.0,-292.0),util.vector3(2851.225830078125,1642.61279296875,-292.0),util.vector3(2968.016845703125,1550.03466796875,-288.0),util.vector3(3125.84814453125,1469.7353515625,-292.0),util.vector3(3298.343017578125,1400.510498046875,-292.0),util.vector3(3516.74365234375,1412.8060302734375,-292.0)}}
local step=1
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Substructure camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on joined corridor')
 if frame==5 then
  local armor=0 local axe=false
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then armor=armor+1 end
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x90613) then axe=true end
  end
  assert(armor==2 and axe,'Joined chest gear missing') print('Joined corridor ready')
 end
 if step<=#points then
  local p=points[step]
  local d=p-self.position
  if math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y)<25 then print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' reached '..tostring(self.position)) step=step+1
  else
   local x,y,f=aim(util.vector3(p.x,p.y,self.position.z+100))
   print(string.format('Joined corridor waypoint %d aim x=%d y=%d',step,x,y))
   if f then print('Joined corridor waypoint '..step..' facing') end
  end
 end
 if frame%15==0 then
  print('Joined corridor Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
  for _,id in ipairs({{0x3b513,0x3b518,0x3b51a}}) do
   local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
   if obj and obj:isValid() then print('Joined room actor '..id..' pos='..tostring(obj.position)..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(obj))..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(obj).current) end
  end
 end
end}}}}
